title: Instant startup
highlights: New sessions paint their first frame in about 20ms instead of about 135ms, and the screen no longer shifts while connecting
Opening several sessions in quick succession is fast again, and resuming large sessions is about three times quicker
New post_tool_feedback hook feeds a script's output back to the model after each tool call, and post_tool hooks now receive the tool input, call id, and touched paths
improvements: The jcode: model prefix and JCODE_OPENROUTER_MODEL are honored, and jcode run fails clearly when --model cannot be applied
Onboarding predicts your default provider and model from existing logins
Expired status notices clear on their own without waiting for a keypress
Old build binaries and stale scratch files are pruned automatically
Web search hints no longer recommend the retired Bing Search API
fixes: New sessions no longer show "Waiting for reload handoff" right after a reload
Copy selections that end inside a wide character include that character
The warning gate fails closed on cargo check errors and prints the diagnostics
